early_import_failure.interpretation: Cache-idle readiness arrives after import readiness. The existing full public test already waits for cache idle and passed. macos_desktop_observation.scope: Chrome activation notifications across the monitored run; 20ms sampled foreground/window observations after PID discovery. No claim of exhaustive detection of every transient window.

verification.affected_build: The only executable change is the standalone Node capability test. Node syntax validation and its real-browser execution passed; no native runtime target changed.
